rederivation_method: Separate Decimal(50) script (/tmp/iter52eval_r2/indep.py) using Boyer-Lindquist equatorial metric components g_tt=-(1-2/u), g_tphi=-2s/u, g_phiphi=u^2+s^2+2s^2/u: omega=-g_tphi/g_phiphi, N^2=-(g_tt-g_tphi^2/g_phiphi), v=sqrt(g_phiphi)(Omega-omega)/N with Omega=1/(u^1.5+s); ISCO by bisection on the Bardeen marginal-stability condition u^2-6u+8s sqrt(u)-3s^2=0 (not the Z1/Z2 closed form); static clock sqrt(-g_tt); Omega_H=-g_tphi/g_phiphi at r_+; SI from IAU GM_sun and c.
